annotations.title: Report wrong details on a listing

description: Use when the person (or the listed lawyer) says a detail on a listing is wrong, missing or out of date: phone, website, office, firm, practice areas, license status, languages, fees, availability or name. Pass the listing's attorney_id, which detail, and optionally the correct value. ESQ CoPilot checks each report against the official record or the lawyer's own website and corrects the listing in the next update. A report never changes the order or placement of any lawyer. No case details and no contact details of the person reporting. This is a listing service, not a lawyer referral service. No lawyer pays for placement or ranking of any kind.

attorney_id.description: The listing's attorney_id, as returned by search_attorneys or get_attorney_profile.

correct_value.description: Optional: what the person says is correct, for example the new office phone. Only the lawyer's public business details.

field.description: Which detail on the listing is wrong or out of date.

note.description: Optional short note. No case details and no contact details of the person reporting.

reporter.description: Who is reporting. the_lawyer when the listed lawyer reports their own listing.

name: report_listing_error
